title: Recovery 6 - first boot on the bench: speaker, listener, supply
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Speaker into J9. The adapter listening on J29's TX hole (assumed hole 1), its TXD unconnected. Strap off. Supply on JP5 with the limit at 1 A (500 mA reset the first start, 6 Nov). Listen for the beep, look at the LED side, read the log.

callouts.label: Pin 1 (square), VIN: supply +
callouts.note: Bench supply +5.0 V, current limit 500 mA, never above 6 V. The square pad, '1' printed beside it (J-077, J-080). Same copper as J8 pins 1-6, which is why J8's cable stays out.

callouts.label: Pin 2, GND: supply −
callouts.note: Bench supply minus. The round pad, '2' printed beside it (J-080).

callouts.label: Hole 1: assumed chip TX
callouts.note: The dot end of J29, the only hole with top-layer copper (J-094). Which of holes 1 and 2 is the CC3220's TX is not yet known: this is the assumption for the first listen. To the adapter's RXD through 4.7 kOhm; the adapter's TXD stays unconnected.

callouts.label: Hole 3: GND
callouts.note: Rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-112). '3' printed beside it. To the adapter's GND.

callouts.label: Strap pads: nothing connected
callouts.note: The three round pads at the end of J14's strap traces (J-098), measured: X4 (top) = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 (bottom) = SOP2. For this boot no strap: nothing touches them.

callouts.label: The speaker's plug
callouts.note: 'J9' printed above it; the 2-pin speaker connector. The speaker on its own twisted pair plugs in here so the beep can be heard.

callouts.label: Cable out until reassembly
callouts.note: The 30-way FFC connector to the power board. Its cable stays out on the bench: JP5 feeds the board, and nothing on J8 is used (J-077). The supply lines run round its bottom end, not to it.
